MacrosInfoDTO.description:
Authored nutrition values, expressed *per* a serving basis.

The nutrients are not necessarily per 100g: Canadian labels usually print
"per <amount> <unit>" (e.g. "per 55 g", "per 1/3 cup"). The ``unit`` and
``amount`` fields record that basis; enrichment scales the values to a
per-100g standard using the conversion graph.

carbs_g.description: Total carbohydrates in grams per the basis amount
carbs_g.title: Carbs G

fat_g.description: Total fat in grams per the basis amount
fat_g.title: Fat G

fiber_g.description: Dietary fiber in grams per the basis amount
fiber_g.title: Fiber G

potassium_mg.description: Potassium in milligrams per the basis amount
potassium_mg.title: Potassium Mg

protein_g.description: Protein in grams per the basis amount
protein_g.title: Protein G

saturated_fat_g.description: Saturated fat in grams per the basis amount
saturated_fat_g.title: Saturated Fat G

sodium_mg.description: Sodium in milligrams per the basis amount
sodium_mg.title: Sodium Mg

sugars_g.description: Total sugars in grams per the basis amount
sugars_g.title: Sugars G

MacrosInfoDTO.title: MacrosInfoDTO

factor.description: Multiplier such that 1 from_unit = factor * to_unit
factor.title: Factor

description:
Ingredient DTO — the authored, validated ingredient document.

Decodes ``data/ingredients/<aisle>.yaml`` and carries raw authored values.
The enriched ``Ingredient`` (in ``meal_prep.models``) is computed later by a
service (``prepare_ingredient``). The ``DTO``     suffix distinguishes this
authored form from the enriched model of the same concept.

conversions.description: Unit conversions. The reserved `package` node's retail edge is authored here as `{from: package, to: <unit>, factor: <amount>}`.
conversions.title: Conversions

custom_units.description: Explicitly registered non-standard units (canonical -> aliases), in the same shape as the standard `allowed` map in units.yaml.
custom_units.title: Custom Units

name.description: Label-style noun for tables and lists (e.g. 'Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breast') — capitalized, slightly more verbose.
name.title: Name

shelf_life_days.description: Mandatory shelf life in days under this storage mode
shelf_life_days.title: Shelf Life Days

step_name.description: Prose noun for flowing instruction text (e.g. 'chicken breast') — lowercase and concise. Required; never derived from `name`.
step_name.title: Step Name

title: IngredientDTO
